description: Read-only Design DNA extractor that parses a local CSS/stylesheet file or fetches a live HTTP(S) webpage URL to extract color palettes, font stacks, spacing scales, border radii, and shadow tokens. Compiles and returns a reusable DesignPreset object and Agent Skill markdown in memory without writing files to disk.

maxStylesheets.description: Optional maximum number of linked external stylesheets to fetch when source is an HTML URL (defaults to 5).

name.description: Optional human-readable identifier for the compiled design preset (defaults to 'extracted-dna').

source.description: Local CSS file path (relative to project root) or full HTTP(S) URL to extract design tokens from.

timeoutMs.description: Optional network timeout in milliseconds per HTTP(S) stylesheet request (defaults to 8000).

name: unslop_extract_dna
